label.purpose: Uppercase labels above titles and stats.

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; border-radius: 10px; padding: .5rem .9rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e2d8); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--card-top, #fff), var(--card-bot, #f1f7f2)); color: var(--ink, #1b2620); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 40%) inset, 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(20 60 40 / 25%); transition: transform .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--brand, #14804f); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #14804f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 10px; padding: .5rem .9rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--brand, #14804f); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--brand-2, #22b573), var(--brand, #14804f)); color: var(--brand-ink, #fff); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 35%) inset, 0 6px 14px -4px var(--brand, #14804f); transition: transform .15s, filter .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #14804f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e2d8); background: var(--surface-2, #faf9f5); padding: .6rem .75rem; font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--ink, #1b2620); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #14804f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stage Badge
components.description: Pill badge for a season stage.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: .125rem .625rem; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--brand, #14804f); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--brand-soft, #d5f0e1), color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand, #14804f) 25%, transparent)); }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--card-top, #fff), var(--card-bot, #f1f7f2)); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e2d8); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 8px 24px -6px rgb(20 60 40 / 14%)); transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-eyebrow { font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #667066); margin: 0; } .ds-card h3 { margin: .25rem 0 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: GDD Progress Bar
components.html: 812 / 1,450 GDD56%
components.css: .ds-gdd-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: .875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-gdd-track { display: block; margin-top: 6px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--line, #e4e2d8); } .ds-gdd-fill { display: block; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand-2, #22b573), var(--brand, #14804f)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--brand, #14804f); }

narrative.overview: A seasonal record where colour follows the weather: leaf green for growth, sky blue for rain, sun amber for heat, rust for warnings. Surfaces sit on warm field paper, lit from above, with soft colour washes drifting in the corners like morning light across a field. Numbers are the content; the almanac frame makes them feel alive without dressing them up.
keyCharacteristics: Weather-coded accents with a strict meaning per hue.
Tactile, raised surfaces with layered soft shadows and a top inner highlight.
Tabular numerals everywhere a number is compared.
Motion is gentle and fully disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Weather Code Rule
rules.body: Each accent means one thing: green is growth, blue is water, amber is heat, rust is trouble. Never use an accent for decoration against its meaning.

rules.name: The Twin Token Rule
rules.body: Every token change is made in three places in globals.css: :root, the dark media query, and [data-theme="dark"].

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that sits next to another number uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Calm App Rule
rules.body: App surfaces use resting shadows and at most one lift per card; shine sweeps, floating and drifting stay on public pages.

dos: Do show the source next to every external number, and a plain "unavailable" line when a source fails.
Do keep all motion inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Do use the stage tone map from src/components/ui.tsx for every stage badge.
donts: Don't add shine, float or drift animations to app surfaces.
Don't use rust or amber for anything other than warnings and heat.
Don't place Aurora washes behind the text column.
Don't show placeholder or skeleton numbers that could be read as data.
